primary.model_class: additive genomic kernel baseline specified by baseline_spec_v1.json

confirmatory_decision.positive_effect_point_exceeds_SESOI: conditional 95% block-bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 AND point delta_Q2 >= 0.01; this is not a practical-importance claim
confirmatory_decision.practical_equivalence: conditional 90% block-bootstrap CI lies entirely in [-0.01, 0.01]

density_availability.COMMON_1M: PREDECLARED_UNAVAILABLE_IN_ALL_237_FROZEN_PARTITIONS; emit UNAVAILABLE and do not fit or cap
density_availability.primary_scope: Tests whether high-quality training-fold COMMON SNP density beyond 250K, up to the fold-specific COMMON_ALL universe, improves prediction.
density_availability.not_identified: This contrast is not a test of 10.7M full-genome density or rare-variant contribution; those require a later MAC5/release-variable branch.

nearclone_scope: No resolved phenotype cohort contains a multi-accession d<=0.001 exact block. The primary split prevents such leakage by construction but is not a relatedness-shift evaluation.
